name: Openai-whisper-api
description: Transcribe audio via OpenAI Whisper or Atlas Cloud speech-to-text APIs.
prompt:
# Audio Transcription APIs (curl)

Transcribe a local audio file through OpenAI Whisper (default) or Atlas Cloud speech-to-text.

## Quick start

```bash
{baseDir}/scripts/transcribe.sh /path/to/audio.m4a
{baseDir}/scripts/transcribe.sh /path/to/audio.m4a --provider atlas
```

Defaults:

- Provider: `openai`
- OpenAI model: `whisper-1`
- Atlas Cloud model: `xai/stt-v1`
- Output: `<input>.txt`

## Useful flags

```bash
{baseDir}/scripts/transcribe.sh /path/to/audio.ogg --model whisper-1 --out /tmp/transcript.txt
{baseDir}/scripts/transcribe.sh /path/to/audio.m4a --provider atlas --language en
{baseDir}/scripts/transcribe.sh /path/to/audio.m4a --provider atlas --prompt "Peter"
{baseDir}/scripts/transcribe.sh /path/to/audio.m4a --json --out /tmp/transcript.json
```

For Atlas Cloud, `--prompt` is sent as one transcription key term and must be at most 50 characters. Atlas submissions are sent once, then polled with bounded GET requests until completion.

## API keys

Set `OPENAI_API_KEY` or `ATLASCLOUD_API_KEY`. You can also configure provider-specific keys in `~/.CoWork-OSS/CoWork-OSS.json`:

```json5
{
  skills: {
    "openai-whisper-api": {
      apiKey: "OPENAI_KEY_HERE",
      atlasApiKey: "ATLAS_KEY_HERE",
    },
  },
}
```
